# Signal Cache

Signal Cache is a small in-memory cache for recent event signals. The project
currently exposes a lookup helper used by tests.

## Repository Scope

This repository does not include deployment code or a cloud cache integration.
Do not document those workflows unless the repository adds them first.

## Verification

Run the test script from the repository root:

```bash
npm test
```
